Venoxis FangRank 1
9% of base mana
2 sec cast8 sec cooldown
Blast an enemy with a jet of toxic venom, dealing 123+0+ShaP*0.65 Shadow Damage, increasing the damage the target takes from this spell by 5% and its mana cost by 5% for 6 sec, stacks 5 times.
